summary:
Comprehensive Super Master Plan for the PrimeCheque Desktop Application — a standalone Sri Lankan cheque writing and printing product. Covers:

- Full project overview, target market, product editions (Personal/Professional/Enterprise)
- Current codebase status analysis (existing scaffold with empty folders)
- Complete technology stack (C#/.NET 8, WinUI 3, SQLite, EF Core, QuestPDF, MVVM)
- Architecture blueprint with dependency injection and MVVM pattern
- Full project folder structure with 80+ planned files
- Complete database schema with 9 entity models (Company, Bank, ChequeBook, Cheque, ChequeAuditLog, BankTemplate, Payee, User, PrinterCalibration)
- 15 service interfaces and implementations
- 14 ViewModels with commands and observable properties
- 14 UI pages with navigation structure
- Bank template engine with JSON configuration for 8 Sri Lankan banks
- Print engine workflow with calibration, test prints, and watermarks
- RBAC role permissions matrix (5 roles)
- Sri Lankan localisation (terminology, CITS compliance, amount-to-words)
- Optional cloud API integration (Laravel)
- 4-phase implementation roadmap with ~55 working days estimate
- Testing strategy (unit, integration, physical print, security, UAT)
- Risk register with mitigations
- KPIs and success metrics
- File-by-file implementation checklist with 80+ items
